settings.question: Where do Leisurecraft products originate from?
settings.answer: All Leisurecraft products offered at Soothing Saunas ship from Canada.

settings.question: How much will it cost to ship my item(s)?
settings.answer:
Leisurecraft offers our customers flat rate shipping on all of their products. Each product category is assigned a different price tier;

  • $320 - Saunas
  • $120 - Furniture, Heaters, Outdoor Showers, and Tiki Bars
  • $55* - Most Accessories

*If heater & accessories are ordered at the same time as a higher tier item, they fall under that product's shipping cost since they are shipped in the same crate as the larger product.

settings.question: Am I responsible for any U.S. Customs or cross border fees?
settings.answer: No, Leisurecraft has agreed to handle the paperwork as well as cover the charges for any cross boarder & U.S. Customs expenses for all of their products.

settings.question: What if I need to change my delivery address?
settings.answer:
If the change of delivery address is requested prior to the order leaving the factory, it can be changed for free.

If the change of delivery address comes in after the order leaves the factory, there is a $250 change fee for this service.

settings.question: How large is the shipping crate?
settings.answer: The dimensions of each shipping crate range from 6 - 14 feet. Please refer to the product details section for your specific item to determine exact measurements.

settings.question: How heavy is my shipping crate?
settings.answer: Shipping crates will weigh between 800 - 1600lbs. Please refer to the product details section for your specific item to determine exact weight.

settings.question: What if my product's shipping crate is longer than 92"?
settings.answer:
The same $320 shipping/delivery fee applies, but the customer is responsible for coordinating the necessary equipment to remove the sauna from the delivery truck bed since there is not a truck with a large enough lift gate to remove/lower the sauna crate from the bed of the truck.

See below for suggestions on equipment needs to offload.

settings.question: What equipment would be needed for delivery day?
settings.answer:
Leisurecraft recommends using a forklift to unload the crate from the delivery truck. Forklift extensions are required. The crate should be picked up from the end of the crate.

Alternatively, a tilt tow truck can be rented to pick up the crate from the shipping terminal and have it delivered to you desired location.

settings.question: How do I prepare for delivery?
settings.answer:
Leisurecraft takes the guess work out of delivery by coordinating curbside delivery direrctly to our customers home for all shipping crates 92" or less. Please see the questions relating to Oversized Shipping Cost If your product's shipping crate is more than 92".

While you wait for your personal sauna to be crafted, please review the assembly instructions linked to each product page in order to ensure all tools and equipment are available and that the item will fit in the desired space.

settings.question: What if I miss the call to arrange delivery, or if I can't get to the terminal to pick up my item?
Are items able to be returned?
settings.answer:
Since all of the products from this manufacture are as ordered, they do not allow returns or exchanges on their products.

Please review all informational material for the product your interested in prior to placing your order to ensure proper fit and functionality in your space.

If product information is missing from your item's page, please email support@soothingsaunas.com so we can provide you with the information & update our site for future guests.

settings.question: What if my item was damaged during shipping?
settings.answer:
No one expects their products to be damaged in transport, but we're aware sometimes accidents happen and so is the Leisurecraft family. If your crate arrives damaged during from the shipping process, you can still accept the shipment, however, when the item gets picked up from the port, or dropped off curbside, please complete the following during delivery/pickup:

  • take pictures of all damaged areas of the shipping crate.
  • note the damage on the shipper's Bill of Lading with "Crate arrived open/damaged - Possible Hidden Damage".
  • Immediately contact Soothing Saunas Support so we can order replacement items for any damaged parts.
